jobs.title: Director, Finance Data Strategy & Stewardship
jobs.description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Finance

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

As a member of the Controllership organisation, the Director of Finance Data Strategy & Stewardship will lead the end-to-end strategy, governance, and lifecycle management of Finance data across the enterprise. This role oversees the intake of new data into the Finance data lake, defines data models and governance standards, and ensures the reliability, quality, and compliance of Finance data used for reporting and analytics. The Director will also manage and develop a dedicated Data Governance and Reporting Controls team located in India, responsible for data stewardship, SOX-related data certification, and support for Finance reporting.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Data Strategy & Intake Management
Define and drive the Finance data strategy, aligned with business priorities and downstream reporting needs.
Oversee the onboarding of new data sources into the Finance data lake, ensuring scalability, traceability, and alignment with enterprise architecture.
Partner with Finance, IT, and product teams to assess new data requirements and convert them into actionable data delivery roadmaps.
Data Modeling & Architecture
Lead the design of enterprise-grade Finance data models and semantic layers to support analytics, regulatory reporting, and operational Finance needs.
Ensure metadata standards, master data alignment, and consistent data definitions across systems.
Collaborate with data architects and engineering teams to ensure robust and efficient data pipelines.
Data Governance & Controls
Establish and enforce data governance standards, policies, and stewardship processes for Finance data.
Oversee the definition and monitoring of data quality rules, issue management, and remediation workflows.
Ensure compliance with SOX controls and certification requirements related to financial data and reporting.
Leadership of the India Data Governance Team
Lead and develop a team in India responsible for data governance, data quality operations, and stewardship activities.
Oversee processes related to Finance reporting controls, SOX testing support, and data certification.
Foster a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership
Work closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, IT, Audit, and Data Engineering leaders to align on priorities and data needs.
Serve as a strategic advisor to senior executives on Finance data risks, data quality, and opportunities to improve reporting and insights.
Drive alignment between business requirements and technical implementation across the data value chain.
Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
Establish KPIs, dashboards, and operating mechanisms to measure data quality, controls effectiveness, and team performance.
Identify and implement process improvements, automation opportunities, and best practices in data governance and data delivery.
Stay current with emerging technologies and regulatory trends shaping Finance data management.

You're Our Person If...

12–15+ years of experience in data management, data governance, Finance data strategy, or related fields.
Strong understanding of Finance processes, accounting flows, and financial reporting requirements; experience in audit or accounting is a plus.
Proven experience designing data models, managing data lakes, and overseeing data ingestion and transformation.
Leadership experience managing global or offshore teams, ideally in shared-services or GCC environments.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence executives and cross-functional partners.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

At Salesforce, we believe in equitable compensation practices that reflect the dynamic nature of labor markets across various regions.

For Ontario-based roles, the base salary hiring range for this position is CAD 160,000 to CAD 210,000 annually.

The range represents base salary only, and does not include company bonus, incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable.

jobs.title: Director, AI Delivery Squad Lead, Underwriting
jobs.description:
The Director of AI, Delivery Squad Lead is accountable for the end-to-end execution of AI powered underwriting initiatives (i.e., Life Insurance Underwriting, Automated Underwriting, Underwriting Decision Support, Advisor Underwriting Experience, and Underwriting Transformation). The role translates Solutioning-defined priorities into delivered AI solutions, ensuring execution with speed, quality, and measurable business impact.

This role requires a deep understanding of life insurance risk assessment and underwriting decision-making to ensure AI solutions appropriately balance growth, customer experience, risk selection, and operational efficiency.

This role is the single point of accountability for delivery execution, ensuring initiatives are effectively scoped, sequenced, executed, and aligned to timelines, capacity, and governance requirements.

The role also provides financial oversight of the delivery portfolio, coordinates dependencies across IT, data, architecture, and business stakeholders, and ensures delivery teams have clear scope, sequencing, and execution expectations.

Position Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Execution

Own the full lifecycle delivery of assigned AI initiatives, from execution planning and backlog readiness through production deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Translate prioritized initiatives into clear work packages, defined scope, team tasks, sequencing, and delivery timelines; ensure the squad understands priorities, responsibilities, and expected outcomes.
Lead the day-to-day execution of data scientists and cross-functional squad members by setting clear accountabilities, monitoring commitments, and maintaining delivery momentum and discipline.
Proactively identify risks, remove blockers, and resolve delivery issues to maintain pace and quality.
Establish and maintain the squad’s delivery operating rhythm, including sprint planning, backlog management, quality controls, and performance reviews.

Translation of Strategy to Execution

Apply deep domain expertise in life insurance risk assessment, underwriting philosophy, and risk selection to guide solution design, prioritize opportunities, and ensure AI capabilities address meaningful underwriting challenges.
Convert Solutioning priorities into execution-ready plans
Leverage deep domain expertise to tailor execution plans to operational, regulatory, and market context, driving measurable business impact
Actively bridge business strategy and technical delivery by contextualizing priorities with industry trends, stakeholder needs, and organizational objectives to ensure alignment and value realization.
Align delivery to business strategy and defined scope
Execute approved priorities within established intake and governance frameworks; provide delivery feasibility, capacity, dependency, and sequencing input without owning intake or portfolio prioritization decisions.

Underwriting AI Delivery Leadership

Lead execution of the underwriting AI portfolio, ensuring each approved initiative progresses through planning, build, validation, production deployment, adoption, and outcome measurement.
Translate underwriting priorities into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Partner with underwriting leaders to modernize underwriting operations through AI.
Partner with underwriting leaders to plan and execute change, training, communications, and operating-process updates required for adoption of AI-enabled underwriting capabilities.
Lead the translation of complex underwriting challenges into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions through close collaboration with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to standardize and reuse underwriting data, models, components, controls, and delivery patterns across products and business units, and coordinate their implementation with platform owners.
Balance growth, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience objectives.

Cross-Functional Delivery Orchestration

Lead cross-functional delivery across data science, engineering, product, business teams, and shared services.
Orchestrate delivery across underwriting, actuarial, product, distribution, data science, engineering, risk, compliance, technology, architecture, and other shared-service partners.
Maintain an integrated dependency plan across systems, data, architecture, controls, operating processes, and delivery partners; resolve or escalate constraints before they affect committed milestones.
Confirm stakeholder decisions, control requirements, operating readiness, and handoffs at each stage of the delivery lifecycle.

Portfolio Management & Delivery Orchestration

Maintain the integrated delivery portfolio view for approved underwriting AI initiatives, showing alignment to segment priorities, OKRs, AI strategy, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, and expected outcomes.
The portfolio may include automated underwriting platforms, underwriting requirement optimization, advisor-facing underwriting assistants, underwriting knowledge and decision-support capabilities, fraud detection, and future-state underwriting transformation initiatives.
Translate the approved roadmap into sequenced, executable portfolio plans with defined milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and capacity constraints.
Coordinate delivery across initiatives by identifying cross-portfolio dependencies, assessing execution trade-offs, and escalating decisions that require Product, Solutioning, or stakeholder prioritization.
Maintain disciplined execution through project controls, risk management, performance reporting, and transparent escalation; recommend re-baselining when assumptions or commitments change and drive approved corrective actions.

Resource & Budget Management

Own resource and financial planning for the approved delivery portfolio, aligning squad capacity, external spend, and funding requirements to committed outcomes and delivery milestones.
Monitor actual and forecast spend, explain variances, and identify emerging resource or funding constraints early enough to support corrective action.
Provide leadership with decision-ready budget updates, including actuals, forecasts, variance drivers, funding risks, and cost estimates for approved or emerging opportunities..

Delivery Governance & Reporting

Operate within established intake, delivery governance, risk, compliance, architecture, and responsible AI frameworks, ensuring required approvals and evidence are completed before key delivery gates.
Contribute delivery estimates, dependency assessments, resource requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical feasibility input so approved initiatives are ready for squad execution.
Provide timely, decision-oriented reporting on progress, milestones, capacity, financial performance, risks, dependencies, outcomes, and required leadership actions.

Value Realization

Ensure each initiative has approved KPIs, baseline measures, target outcomes, accountable business owners, and an agreed measurement approach before delivery begins.
Track delivery, adoption, operational, customer, risk, and financial measures through implementation and value realization.
Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to validate assumptions, estimates and realized value, and support reporting aligned to business expectations
Measure and report underwriting outcomes, including increased capacity and new-business throughput; reduced cycle times, unnecessary requirements, and operating costs; higher straight-through processing rates; improved underwriting consistency; and a better advisor experience.

People Leadership

Build squad delivery capability by coaching cross-functional teams, strengthening delivery practices, and reinforcing predictable, high-quality execution.

Required Qualifications

Life insurance underwriting, risk assessment, and risk selection principles, including understanding mortality and morbidity drivers, underwriting decision frameworks and AI-enabled decision support.
Experience with insurance product manufacturing and distribution, including advisor and customer experience.
Experience operating in regulated insurance and compliance environments.
Enterprise AI product and solution delivery experience, including cross-functional execution from planning through production deployment and value realization.
Understanding of agentic AI patterns and safeguards, including orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, permissions, auditability, failure handling, and human escalation.
Experience with grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, evaluation, observability, and responsible AI controls for accurate, reliable, and compliant GenAI solutions.
Experience delivering enterprise GenAI solutions, with knowledge of foundation models, orchestration, APIs, vector retrieval, data integration, deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Experience applying advance analytics, machine learning, AI, or decision science to solve complex underwriting, risk management, or insurance business challenges.
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, governance, and executive-level portfolio reporting.
Strong stakeholder leadership and ability to bridge underwriting business priorities with technical delivery.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

jobs.title: Vice President, Finance Operations & Transformation
jobs.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Our headquarters and most of our team are based in Ottawa. For employees located in Ottawa,

this role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately four days per week

in the office at our headquarters. We also welcome remote candidates from anywhere in Canada

About The Team

The Vice President, Finance Operations & Transformation is a senior finance executive responsible for leading and scaling a modern finance operations team for a public company.

This leader owns the operational backbone of Finance: accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll operations, procurement, deal desk governance, customer contracting, and finance operations transformation.

The mandate is not simply to run today’s processes; it is to redesign and modernize them so the company can scale efficiently, improve the employee and customer experience, strengthen financial discipline, and operate with greater speed, consistency, automation, and insight.

The successful candidate will bring a transformation mindset and a strong operating cadence. They will be equally comfortable improving day-to-day execution, creating enterprise-wide standards, partnering with Sales and Legal on complex commercial transactions, working with IT on systems and workflow automation, and leading change across the finance organization.

Vacancy Status

This is an existing job vacancy

What you will do

Lead global finance operations across accounts receivable, accounts payable, payroll operations, procurement, customer contracting and deal desk governance.
Ensure the efficient and accurate processing of all financial transactions, application of internal controls, and compliance with company policies and procedures.
Lead the team and serve as a global advisor on deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial terms to optimize revenue outcomes. Provide strategic insights into deal dependencies, risks, and opportunities to support global planning and execution.
Lead the transformation of finance operations by improving processes, leveraging technology, and introducing automation and AI where they create business value.
Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, or eliminate manual processes across financial operations.
Grow teams, develop leaders across the portfolio, and create an environment that supports collaboration, operational excellence, and modern enterprise thinking

What we are looking for

15 years of progressive financial leadership experience.
Significant experience with finance operations, finance transformation, procurement operations, or related environments.
Knowledge of industry best practices and emerging trends in finance transformation.
Proven ability to modernize processes through standardization, automation, analytics, AI-enabled tools, and operating model redesign.
Strong leadership skills to provide vision and support to the Finance team, mentor individuals, and develop high-performing talent.

#VP

#DF-LI1

Work With Impact:
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands:
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
Flexible work options
Physical and mental well-being programs
Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
Mentorship programs, training, and career development
Recognition programs and referral rewards
Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Executive

jobs.title: AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition and Readiness
jobs.description:
Manulife Canada is transforming how operational work is received, processed, routed, completed and measured across servicing functions. This includes retiring legacy workflow platforms, re-engineering operational processes, modernizing technology architecture, and introducing reusable AI-enabled automation capabilities that improve service, strengthen controls, and create a more scalable operating model. This position will help lead the transformation program supporting this vision while establishing reusable business and technology capabilities that can be applied across future modernization initiatives.

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition & Readiness will play a pivotal leadership role in one of Manulife Canada's largest operational transformation programs. The successful candidate will be accountable for integrated program delivery, transition management, operational readiness, release governance, and execution of the legacy workflow system retirement roadmap across multiple transformation waves.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, technology and delivery. The successful candidate will ensure business capabilities are deployed safely, the organization is prepared to operate through interim states, and transformation outcomes are successfully scaled across the enterprise.

Position Responsibilities

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition & Readiness is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing and executing the transformation roadmap. The role leads the Program Management Office while also establishing the transition strategies, release governance, readiness practices and operating-model controls required to move the organization from current-state operations to future-state operations. The role owns delivery execution and operational implementation of the transformation.

Program and Portfolio Delivery

Own the integrated transformation roadmap.
Govern program schedules, milestones and delivery commitments.
Manage critical path dependencies and inter-workstream coordination.
Lead program governance forums and executive reporting.
Establish delivery performance measures and escalation mechanisms.
Maintain integrated views of scope, timeline, financials and risks.

PMO Leadership

Lead and develop the Program Management Office.
Establish governance processes, standards and controls.
Manage executive reporting, dashboards, status reviews and Steering Committee materials.
Oversee RAID management and dependency tracking.
Coordinate planning across business, technology and delivery workstreams.

Transition Management

Develop the enterprise transition strategy for workflow system retirement.
Define interim-state operating models and deployment approaches.
Establish coexistence strategies for legacy and future-state environments.
Coordinate cutover and rollout planning across business units.
Manage hypercare, stabilization and post-deployment support activities.
Ensure operational continuity throughout transformation waves.

Operational Readiness

Define operational readiness frameworks and checkpoints.
Establish release-level go-live criteria.
Coordinate readiness assessments across business and technology stakeholders.
Ensure operational support models are established and sustainable.
Govern release approvals and deployment decision processes.

Integration Readiness & Ecosystem Coordination

Govern cross-platform dependency management.
Coordinate ecosystem readiness activities across impacted applications.
Track platform onboarding, retirement and transition activities.
Monitor system integration risks impacting rollout schedules.
Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Technology leaders to establish release readiness.
Govern temporary bridge solutions required during transformation waves.

Workflow System Retirement Execution

Maintain workflow system retirement execution plan.
Track retirement dependencies and readiness criteria.
Coordinate enterprise-wide retirement planning activities.
Ensure all retirement risks are identified and managed.
Support final platform decommissioning and transition activities.

Required Qualifications

10+ years leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs.
Experience managing multi-year technology and operations transformation initiatives.
Proven track record establishing PMO and governance functions.
Experience executing phased technology migrations and platform retirements.
Strong understanding of operational readiness, deployment management and transition planning.
Experience managing third-party delivery partners and systems integrators.
Financial services, insurance or operations transformation experience preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with AWD or a comparable workflow platform, such as Pega, Appian, or FileNet, at scale.
Experience establishing reusable automation components or shared engineering services across business units.
Experience delivering transformation in a federally regulated financial institution, including familiarity with OSFI expectations for change and outsourcing.

When You Join Our Team

We’ll empower you to learn and grow the career you want.
We’ll recognize and support you in a flexible environment where well-being and inclusion are more than just words.
As part of our global team, we’ll support you in shaping the future you want to see.

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

Our headquarters and most of our team are based in Ottawa. For employees located in Ottawa,

this role follows a hybrid work model, with an expectation of approximately four days per week

in the office at our headquarters. We also welcome remote candidates from anywhere in

Canada.

About The Role

The Vice President, Financial Accounting & Reporting is a senior accounting and controllership executive for a global public company. Working in close partnership with the CFO, the VP, Financial Accounting & Reporting ensures the integrity, discipline, and operational effectiveness of the company’s financial management framework across accounting, financial reporting, internal controls, audit oversight, compliance, and revenue accounting globally.

The role serves as a trusted advisor to the CFO and Audit Committee on financial governance, controllership, regulatory readiness, and enterprise risk management related to financial operations and reporting

Lead the day-to-day operating rhythm of the accounting, external reporting, and internal control functions, with accountability for efficient and accurate close processes, disciplined financial administration, and effective oversight of core accounting operations and global compliance.

Oversee audit readiness, external audit coordination, control certification support, Canada NI 52-109 requirements, U.S. Sarbanes-Oxley readiness, and the operational processes required to maintain a strong compliance posture across jurisdictions.
Partner with risk management and internal audit.
Support the CFO in Audit Committee matters and serve as a senior operational counterpart on financial governance, controls, and compliance topics.
Ensure accounting processes scale effectively as the business grows in complexity across geographies, products, commercial models, and regulatory obligations.
Grow high-performing teams and create an environment that supports collaboration, operational excellence, and modern enterprise thinking.

15 years of progressive financial leadership experience.
Significant experience with public-company reporting, external audit, internal controls,

regulatory compliance, and Audit Committee support.

TSX experience is required; NASDAQ and NYSE experience is highly desirable.
Deep knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, SOX, and internal control frameworks is highly

desirable, including direct experience owning SOX/ICFR programs.

Strong understanding of revenue recognition (IFRS 15/ASC 606) and operational finance

best practices.

Big Four public accounting background, particularly with public-company audit, SEC/OSC

Strong presentation and communication skills at the senior management and board level

Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. new_jobs.title: Director, AI Delivery Squad Lead, Underwriting
new_jobs.description:
The Director of AI, Delivery Squad Lead is accountable for the end-to-end execution of AI powered underwriting initiatives (i.e., Life Insurance Underwriting, Automated Underwriting, Underwriting Decision Support, Advisor Underwriting Experience, and Underwriting Transformation). The role translates Solutioning-defined priorities into delivered AI solutions, ensuring execution with speed, quality, and measurable business impact.

This role requires a deep understanding of life insurance risk assessment and underwriting decision-making to ensure AI solutions appropriately balance growth, customer experience, risk selection, and operational efficiency.

This role is the single point of accountability for delivery execution, ensuring initiatives are effectively scoped, sequenced, executed, and aligned to timelines, capacity, and governance requirements.

The role also provides financial oversight of the delivery portfolio, coordinates dependencies across IT, data, architecture, and business stakeholders, and ensures delivery teams have clear scope, sequencing, and execution expectations.

Position Responsibilities

End-to-End Delivery Execution

Own the full lifecycle delivery of assigned AI initiatives, from execution planning and backlog readiness through production deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Translate prioritized initiatives into clear work packages, defined scope, team tasks, sequencing, and delivery timelines; ensure the squad understands priorities, responsibilities, and expected outcomes.
Lead the day-to-day execution of data scientists and cross-functional squad members by setting clear accountabilities, monitoring commitments, and maintaining delivery momentum and discipline.
Proactively identify risks, remove blockers, and resolve delivery issues to maintain pace and quality.
Establish and maintain the squad’s delivery operating rhythm, including sprint planning, backlog management, quality controls, and performance reviews.

Translation of Strategy to Execution

Apply deep domain expertise in life insurance risk assessment, underwriting philosophy, and risk selection to guide solution design, prioritize opportunities, and ensure AI capabilities address meaningful underwriting challenges.
Convert Solutioning priorities into execution-ready plans
Leverage deep domain expertise to tailor execution plans to operational, regulatory, and market context, driving measurable business impact
Actively bridge business strategy and technical delivery by contextualizing priorities with industry trends, stakeholder needs, and organizational objectives to ensure alignment and value realization.
Align delivery to business strategy and defined scope
Execute approved priorities within established intake and governance frameworks; provide delivery feasibility, capacity, dependency, and sequencing input without owning intake or portfolio prioritization decisions.

Underwriting AI Delivery Leadership

Lead execution of the underwriting AI portfolio, ensuring each approved initiative progresses through planning, build, validation, production deployment, adoption, and outcome measurement.
Translate underwriting priorities into executable roadmaps and delivery plans.
Partner with underwriting leaders to modernize underwriting operations through AI.
Partner with underwriting leaders to plan and execute change, training, communications, and operating-process updates required for adoption of AI-enabled underwriting capabilities.
Lead the translation of complex underwriting challenges into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions through close collaboration with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.
Identify opportunities to standardize and reuse underwriting data, models, components, controls, and delivery patterns across products and business units, and coordinate their implementation with platform owners.
Balance growth, risk, operational efficiency, and customer experience objectives.

Cross-Functional Delivery Orchestration

Lead cross-functional delivery across data science, engineering, product, business teams, and shared services.
Orchestrate delivery across underwriting, actuarial, product, distribution, data science, engineering, risk, compliance, technology, architecture, and other shared-service partners.
Maintain an integrated dependency plan across systems, data, architecture, controls, operating processes, and delivery partners; resolve or escalate constraints before they affect committed milestones.
Confirm stakeholder decisions, control requirements, operating readiness, and handoffs at each stage of the delivery lifecycle.

Portfolio Management & Delivery Orchestration

Maintain the integrated delivery portfolio view for approved underwriting AI initiatives, showing alignment to segment priorities, OKRs, AI strategy, dependencies, milestones, capacity, risks, and expected outcomes.
The portfolio may include automated underwriting platforms, underwriting requirement optimization, advisor-facing underwriting assistants, underwriting knowledge and decision-support capabilities, fraud detection, and future-state underwriting transformation initiatives.
Translate the approved roadmap into sequenced, executable portfolio plans with defined milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and capacity constraints.
Coordinate delivery across initiatives by identifying cross-portfolio dependencies, assessing execution trade-offs, and escalating decisions that require Product, Solutioning, or stakeholder prioritization.
Maintain disciplined execution through project controls, risk management, performance reporting, and transparent escalation; recommend re-baselining when assumptions or commitments change and drive approved corrective actions.

Resource & Budget Management

Own resource and financial planning for the approved delivery portfolio, aligning squad capacity, external spend, and funding requirements to committed outcomes and delivery milestones.
Monitor actual and forecast spend, explain variances, and identify emerging resource or funding constraints early enough to support corrective action.
Provide leadership with decision-ready budget updates, including actuals, forecasts, variance drivers, funding risks, and cost estimates for approved or emerging opportunities..

Delivery Governance & Reporting

Operate within established intake, delivery governance, risk, compliance, architecture, and responsible AI frameworks, ensuring required approvals and evidence are completed before key delivery gates.
Contribute delivery estimates, dependency assessments, resource requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical feasibility input so approved initiatives are ready for squad execution.
Provide timely, decision-oriented reporting on progress, milestones, capacity, financial performance, risks, dependencies, outcomes, and required leadership actions.

Value Realization

Ensure each initiative has approved KPIs, baseline measures, target outcomes, accountable business owners, and an agreed measurement approach before delivery begins.
Track delivery, adoption, operational, customer, risk, and financial measures through implementation and value realization.
Collaborate with Finance stakeholders to validate assumptions, estimates and realized value, and support reporting aligned to business expectations
Measure and report underwriting outcomes, including increased capacity and new-business throughput; reduced cycle times, unnecessary requirements, and operating costs; higher straight-through processing rates; improved underwriting consistency; and a better advisor experience.

People Leadership

Build squad delivery capability by coaching cross-functional teams, strengthening delivery practices, and reinforcing predictable, high-quality execution.

Required Qualifications

Life insurance underwriting, risk assessment, and risk selection principles, including understanding mortality and morbidity drivers, underwriting decision frameworks and AI-enabled decision support.
Experience with insurance product manufacturing and distribution, including advisor and customer experience.
Experience operating in regulated insurance and compliance environments.
Enterprise AI product and solution delivery experience, including cross-functional execution from planning through production deployment and value realization.
Understanding of agentic AI patterns and safeguards, including orchestration, planning, memory, tool use, permissions, auditability, failure handling, and human escalation.
Experience with grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt design, evaluation, observability, and responsible AI controls for accurate, reliable, and compliant GenAI solutions.
Experience delivering enterprise GenAI solutions, with knowledge of foundation models, orchestration, APIs, vector retrieval, data integration, deployment, adoption, and value realization.
Experience applying advance analytics, machine learning, AI, or decision science to solve complex underwriting, risk management, or insurance business challenges.
Demonstrated ability to manage delivery risks, dependencies, resources, budgets, governance, and executive-level portfolio reporting.
Strong stakeholder leadership and ability to bridge underwriting business priorities with technical delivery.

new_jobs.title: AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition and Readiness
new_jobs.description:
Manulife Canada is transforming how operational work is received, processed, routed, completed and measured across servicing functions. This includes retiring legacy workflow platforms, re-engineering operational processes, modernizing technology architecture, and introducing reusable AI-enabled automation capabilities that improve service, strengthen controls, and create a more scalable operating model. This position will help lead the transformation program supporting this vision while establishing reusable business and technology capabilities that can be applied across future modernization initiatives.

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition & Readiness will play a pivotal leadership role in one of Manulife Canada's largest operational transformation programs. The successful candidate will be accountable for integrated program delivery, transition management, operational readiness, release governance, and execution of the legacy workflow system retirement roadmap across multiple transformation waves.

This role sits at the intersection of operations, technology and delivery. The successful candidate will ensure business capabilities are deployed safely, the organization is prepared to operate through interim states, and transformation outcomes are successfully scaled across the enterprise.

Position Responsibilities

The AVP, Transformation Delivery, Transition & Readiness is accountable for planning, coordinating, governing and executing the transformation roadmap. The role leads the Program Management Office while also establishing the transition strategies, release governance, readiness practices and operating-model controls required to move the organization from current-state operations to future-state operations. The role owns delivery execution and operational implementation of the transformation.

Own the integrated transformation roadmap.
Govern program schedules, milestones and delivery commitments.
Manage critical path dependencies and inter-workstream coordination.
Lead program governance forums and executive reporting.
Establish delivery performance measures and escalation mechanisms.
Maintain integrated views of scope, timeline, financials and risks.

PMO Leadership

Lead and develop the Program Management Office.
Establish governance processes, standards and controls.
Manage executive reporting, dashboards, status reviews and Steering Committee materials.
Oversee RAID management and dependency tracking.
Coordinate planning across business, technology and delivery workstreams.

Transition Management

Develop the enterprise transition strategy for workflow system retirement.
Define interim-state operating models and deployment approaches.
Establish coexistence strategies for legacy and future-state environments.
Coordinate cutover and rollout planning across business units.
Manage hypercare, stabilization and post-deployment support activities.
Ensure operational continuity throughout transformation waves.

Operational Readiness

Define operational readiness frameworks and checkpoints.
Establish release-level go-live criteria.
Coordinate readiness assessments across business and technology stakeholders.
Ensure operational support models are established and sustainable.
Govern release approvals and deployment decision processes.

Integration Readiness & Ecosystem Coordination

Govern cross-platform dependency management.
Coordinate ecosystem readiness activities across impacted applications.
Track platform onboarding, retirement and transition activities.

Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Technology leaders to establish release readiness.

Workflow System Retirement Execution

Track retirement dependencies and readiness criteria.
Coordinate enterprise-wide retirement planning activities.
Ensure all retirement risks are identified and managed.
Support final platform decommissioning and transition activities.

10+ years leading large-scale enterprise transformation programs.
Experience managing multi-year technology and operations transformation initiatives.
Proven track record establishing PMO and governance functions.
Experience executing phased technology migrations and platform retirements.
Strong understanding of operational readiness, deployment management and transition planning.
Experience managing third-party delivery partners and systems integrators.
Financial services, insurance or operations transformation experience preferred.

Experience establishing reusable automation components or shared engineering services across business units.

new_jobs.title: Leader, Enterprise Compliance
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Every transaction matters. Every Canadian matters. At Interac, we protect both — driving trust, security, and inclusion, so our digital economy thrives.

Founded in 1984, Interac connects Canadians through secure digital payments, advanced identity verification and industry-leading fraud protection. Connecting banks, businesses, and individuals, Interac enables millions to send, receive, and manage money safely and effortlessly every day — across both digital and physical environments.

As the backbone of Canada’s financial ecosystem, Interac facilitates over 20 million transactions daily, supported by trusted partnerships with government and financial institutions. Consistently ranked as Canada’s most reputable financial technology brand, Interac is deeply embedded in the daily lives of Canadians.

Who You Will Work With:

The Leader, Enterprise Compliance role will report to Rebecca Ma.

What You Will Do:

Enterprise Compliance Strategy & Leadership

Developing and executing Interac's multi-year enterprise compliance strategy and roadmap.
Monitoring regulatory developments, emerging risks, and industry trends to ensure the compliance program remains effective and future-focused.
Advising executive leadership and the Board on compliance program effectiveness, risks, priorities, and strategic direction.

Governance, Risk & Compliance Enablement

Leading the development and maintenance of enterprise compliance policies, standards, frameworks, and governance structures.
Supporting and advancing Interac's Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) program to strengthen consistency and accountability across the organization.
Ensuring regulatory requirements are effectively integrated into business operations and decision-making.

Compliance Oversight & Risk Management

Providing independent oversight, challenge, and guidance on regulatory and compliance risks.
Leading enterprise compliance assessments, gap analyses, and remediation initiatives.
Partnering with Legal, Privacy, Information Security, Internal Audit, Human Resources, and business leaders to strengthen risk management and compliance practices.

Culture, Capability & Leadership

Building, mentoring, and developing a high-performing compliance team.
Driving enterprise-wide compliance awareness, education, and culture initiatives.
Ensuring the compliance function maintains the capability and capacity required to meet evolving regulatory expectations.

Executive & Board Reporting

Developing and delivering executive and Board-level reporting on compliance risks, program maturity, and strategic initiatives.
Leveraging metrics, analytics, key performance indicators, and key risk indicators to support decision-making and organizational transparency.

What You Bring:

A university degree in Business, Management, Law, or a related field.
10+ years of progressive experience leading enterprise compliance, risk management, governance, regulatory affairs, or related functions within a regulated environment.
Experience designing, implementing, and evolving enterprise compliance frameworks and programs.
Strong knowledge of governance, regulatory compliance, risk management, and control frameworks.
Experience presenting to senior executives, Boards of Directors, and regulatory bodies.
Exceptional business acumen and the ability to balance regulatory requirements, organizational risk appetite, and business objectives.
Demonstrated experience leading teams and influencing complex enterprise-wide initiatives.
Professional designations such as CRM or CPA are considered assets.

You're great at:

Influencing senior leaders and stakeholders without direct authority.
Translating complex regulatory and risk issues into clear, actionable business insights.
Exercising sound judgment in ambiguous and highly complex situations.
Building strong relationships across multiple functions and levels of the organization.
Navigating sensitive matters with professionalism, discretion, and diplomacy.
Leading through change while maintaining focus on long-term strategic outcomes.

What We’re Offering:

The hiring range for this position is $170,000.00 - $190,000.00
, and you will also be eligible for our short-term incentive plan. The exact amount will depend on factors such as skills, experience, and job-related knowledge, but Interac’s commitment goes beyond compensation. Our Total Rewards package is designed to support your well-being and future, and includes:

Generous vacation and wellness days to help you recharge
Comprehensive employer-paid benefits coverage for peace of mind
Market-leading employer-funded RRSP program to invest in your future
Flexible hybrid work model for better work-life balance
Access to a free and confidential 24/7 employee & family assistance program to offer support for you and your immediate family
Pregnancy and parental leave top-up to support growing families
Charitable donation matching with United Way to amplify your impact

Why Join Us?

At Interac, the impact we make, and the people who drive it, is profound. When you become part of our team, you’re joining a purpose-driven organization that’s shaping the future of digital finance in Canada. Here’s what you can expect:

Investing in the Future – Help us unlock digital prosperity for all Canadians.
Innovative Thinking – Collaborate on products, practices, and platforms that redefine what’s possible.
Inclusive Culture – Be empowered to bring your whole self to work and realize your full potential.
Inspiring Community – Work in an ecosystem where we lift each other up and rise together.
Intentional Support – Enjoy flexible, supportive offerings that prioritize your total wellness.

Additional Pre-Employment Requirements:

To ensure the integrity of our organization, successful candidates will be required to complete background checks, which may include, Canadian Criminal Credit Check, Canadian ID Cross-Check, Public Safety Verification, 5-year Employment Verification, Education Verification, Credit Check, and Social Media Check.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Interac is also an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We believe that innovation thrives when people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together. That’s why we are committed to providing fair and equitable employment opportunities for all individuals, without discrimination based on race, color, ancestry, ethnic origin, place of origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

If you require accommodation during any stage of the application or recruitment process, please contact us at humanresources@interac.ca. We will work with you to meet your needs.
